Shares rose 6.02% over the past week but remain down 19.31% year to date and sit well below the 52-week high of $498.83. Q2 2026 revenue jumped 25.5% to $28.24 billion on record deliveries of 480,126 vehicles, but non-GAAP EPS of $0.33 missed by 38.51%.
